name: Mind Seed (1/Day)
description: The creature touches one humanoid, which must succeed on a DC 21 Intelligence saving throw or be cursed. The curse lasts until it’s removed by a remove curse or greater restoration spell. The cursed target suffers 1 level of exhaustion every 24 hours, and finishing a long rest doesn’t reduce its exhaustion. If the cursed target reaches exhaustion level 6, it doesn’t die; it instead becomes a thrall under the creature’s control, and all its exhaustion is removed. Only the wish spell can free the thrall from this control.
